data.name: Pantheons Clash: Crystal
data.detailed_description:
A new epoch of the Divine Calendar dawns, and all things are in upheaval. Amid the chaos of space and time, the 【Gate of Realms】 has appeared, connecting the realms of the gods...

Zeus, the Sovereign of Gods, seized this once-in-a-millennium opportunity and was the first to claim the 【Power of the Gate】. Leading the assembled great gods of 【Olympus】, he seeks to unite the heavenly realm and become the one true 【King of All Gods】.

The Eastern gods now stand as the final force resisting the God King...

Game Features

  • With over 200 card characters, choose your faction freely and build your very own divine team!

  • Featuring comic-grade art, the game brings more than 200 gods vividly to life before your eyes. Exquisite 2D character art paired with Spine skeletal animation, combined with real-time 3D combat, delivers an immersive visual experience.

  • Team composition is an art — assemble your card lineup wisely to unleash explosive, peak damage and defeat your foes.

  • Eastern, Greek, Indian... the gods clash, each showing their divine might! Massive launch rewards help you ascend to godhood first and carve out a legend of your own!
